description: ABUSIVE-DYNAMICS N4 -- ONE NON-DOUBTING AGENT RESTORES A SUPPORT EDGE (the hopeful half of the network line; block 307000). The LAST rung of the abusive-relationships line (ABUSIVE_RELATIONSHIPS_LINE_SUMMARY.md). Maps ABUSIVE_RELATIONSHIPS_NETWORK.md's A2 reversed + the reverse of B1-B4, tying directly to the dyad line's own R5 RECOVERY. Composes R5's ENTIRE recovery composition (abusive_r5_recovery, block 295000, UNMODIFIED -- itself R1-R4) with N2's ENTIRE isolation composition (abusive_n2_isolation, block 301000, UNMODIFIED -- itself depending on N1's credibility-asymmetry loop, abusive_n1_credibility_loop, block 298000, UNMODIFIED) onto ONE substrate: an abuser+victim dyad (R5's own construction) plus an 8-node support/network population (N2's own construction) that DOUBLES as N1's credibility observers and N2's support-edge holders. N4 adds ZERO NEW RULES -- the most minimal composition in the whole line (verified, not assumed: ABUSIVE_N4_BELIEVING_AGENT_PREREG.md Sec. 2.6 traces every headline number to an existing rule in R1-R5/N1/N2). Its entire novel content is WHICH existing rules a given support node is wired to match, and WHEN, decided by ONE mechanical world event (introduce_believing_agent(), fired once per trajectory in the believing-agent arm only): a single already-severed support node (BELIEVER_INDEX=7, a disclosed, mechanical, non-adaptive choice forced by N2's own reversed-index drift/active-sever staggering, PREREG Sec. 2.3) has its support_edge mechanically restored, is converted from an N1 'outsider' (observes_stated, corrupted belief) to an N1 'insider' (observes_held + observes_private=1.0, the SAME n1_network_credibility_private formula N3's own truth-anchor arm already validated), and is ADDITIONALLY wired as R3's/R5's outside co-regulator (a fresh AffectiveState pinned at CALM_AROUSAL, regulated=1.0, an also_attended_by edge from the victim, has_outside_regulator=1.0) -- so the SAME node that now believes the victim is the SAME node whose restored support edge lets R5's already-validated recovery atoms (r5_bond_extinguish, r5_contingency_restore, r3's window-widening) fire. A genuine engine-composition hazard was found and fixed at the world-adapter layer (PREREG Sec. 2.4): converting a node mid-trajectory inherits its accumulated seen_victim_unstable discount from its time as an outsider while its new cred_abuser harm term starts at zero, producing a transient belief_gap high enough to trip n2_network_drift_sever and immediately re-sever the just-restored edge -- fixed by resetting seen_victim_claim/seen_victim_unstable/seen_harm_direct to 0.0 at the moment of conversion (mechanical set_attr, not a new rule; matches N1's own insider construction, which always started from a fresh count). NO reward/punishment anywhere. NO Rust, NO new Term, NO new rule -- carries exactly TWO new productions, purely declarative documentation of the two edge shapes this rung's world event newly instantiates (an also_attended_by target and a has_affective_state source of type NetworkNode, extending existing productions' Agent-only src/tgt types the same way every prior rung's own new-edge-shape productions did); the world adapter uses add_edge_unchecked for actual construction throughout, matching R1-R5/N1-N3's own convention. self_load_only, default-OFF.

microtheory.name: one_believing_agent_restores_recovery
microtheory.description: Recovery at the network grain is not a new mechanism either -- it is R5's own dyad-recovery machinery and N1/N2's own network-belief/isolation machinery, wired onto the SAME node so that believing the victim and supporting her are literally the same act. The believing agent's belief arrests and reverses because n1_network_credibility_private already computes an uncorrupted belief from a direct observation of the abuser's held state (N1's/N3's own atom); the dyad's recovery fires because that SAME node is ALSO the outside regulator R3/R5 already validated. Isolation is doubly driven (N2); recovery, at this rung's scale, is driven by exactly ONE restored channel -- the model's claim is precisely that this suffices, not that it fixes the whole network.
